part.text:
Fixed. In `createStaticHandler` (routergroup.go:208), when a static file isn't found the context was re-routed to `engine.allNoRoute`, which includes global middleware (Logger, Recovery) already executed by the matched route — running them twice and producing two log lines. Changed it to `engine.noRoute`, which contains only the user's NoRoute handlers.

All tests pass, including the reproduction test `TestMiddlewareCalledOnceByRouterStaticFSNotFound` and the rest of the suite (`go test ./...` green).
